$comment: Classification of Cloudflare workspaces. Checked by tools/check-workers.mjs. railsBacked: OpenNext apps that fetch from Rails. EMPTY since every frame moved to Vite — kept rather than deleted because the class still describes a shape this repository could take again, and the checks it drives are the only record of what an OpenNext frame had to declare. railsBackedVite: the three TanStack Start Cores, built with Vite + @cloudflare/vite-plugin — so no ASSETS/IMAGES/WORKER_SELF_REFERENCE bindings and no assets.directory (the plugin writes them into the output config), plus a `local` tier because vite dev runs in workerd. They reach Rails over the public internet at the per-tier `RAILS_ORIGIN` var and must declare no VPC binding. See adr/013-frames-tanstack-start.md and adr/018-core-rails-direct-internet.md. contentSurface: OpenNext apps that do not talk to Rails and must carry no VPC binding at all. standalone: Hono apex workers, no Rails. external: hosted outside Cloudflare, no wrangler config; empty since dev/acme was removed and dev/apex moved onto Workers.
$vpcDevelopmentServiceIdComment: The development VPC Service `umaxica-dev-rails-api`, bound to the DEDICATED Workers VPC tunnel `umaxica-dev-workers-vpc` (03a4a67c-2aca-4f2c-9aeb-d1666f18bc87) and terminating on core-workers-vpc.internal:3000 in the Global repository's Podman `frontend` network. Verify with `wrangler vpc service get <id>`. Two properties are deliberate and must survive any future edit. (1) The tunnel is this path's alone: until 2026-09-05 the service was bound to 1d501e9a-… (`Auth`), which also serves the published browser hostnames behind Access, so every ingress, replica or token change there moved the Edge Worker's only route to Rails. (2) The target is a plain Compose alias, not a `*.localhost` name and not a container address: RFC 6761 makes glibc resolve anything under `localhost.` to loopback, which is why the old record had to name the ephemeral Podman address 10.89.2.2. See the Global repository's docs/operations/cloudflare-private-origin.md.
$vpcProductionServiceIdComment: BOOTSTRAP: equal to vpcDevelopmentServiceId on purpose. AWS production Rails and a production tunnel do not exist yet, so the deployed production Worker exercises the real edge → Workers VPC → VPC Service → tunnel → Rails path against local Rails. This field is the AWS cutover point: provision the production VPC Service, change this id and the fifteen top-level service_ids, and the two stop being equal. No application code changes. See adr/006-development-workers-vpc-transport.md.
